snapshot.how: the product's own composer, live mapper and record-shape guard, imported and RUN from a read-only `git archive` of the pinned commit. Not a transcription. Re-dump rather than hand-edit.
snapshot.liveReadBasis: no credential was used and no vendor was called by this design; every live-path fact here is a property of the code at this commit, not of a reading

states.fifthStateBasis: a domain absent from DOMAIN_REGISTRY has no entry in DOMAIN_STATUSES on purpose: absent from the registry means the surface does not exist, which is the only surviving meaning of Not built
states.liveStateBasis: src/vendor-live.mjs returns status "unavailable" from unavailableResult; the fixture seam never produces it, so it is not in DOMAIN_STATUSES
